title: ahwootech/BRUTAL
why_read: An open-source low-level C# game engine framework offering direct access to native APIs and Vulkan, notable for underpinning real shipped projects like RimWorld's new engine.
analysis: BRUTAL is a C# framework for building games or game engines with direct, low-level access to native APIs and the Vulkan graphics API, bypassing higher-level abstractions typical of C# game development. What makes it credible is that it reportedly underlies Kitten Space Agency and RimWorld's Waylith engine, meaning it has real production usage rather than being just a hobby project. For engine programmers, having thin low-level bindings in C# rather than C++ is an interesting tradeoff between performance and developer ergonomics. This is a solid technical resource for engineers building custom game engines who want to avoid heavier frameworks like Unity or Unreal.
